Docs.summary: Provides media session identifiers, metric reports, and playback and editing events.

remarks.para: Use to create a metrics session. Use the event and report builders to supply measurements, then pass the result to the corresponding session reporting method.

identifies a session and can associate it with lower-level media components. Event timestamps are elapsed milliseconds since creation of the associated log session, not wall-clock timestamps. Close a session to release its identifier.
